overview: While Two Gentlemen played at the Cross Keys, you stayed at the desk. You were not in that play. You brought on the pedant, the braggart, the hedge-priest and the boy to present the Worthies, and you wrote that the pageant breaks up in laughter. Nothing follows it yet. The light was going.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote two lines and stopped while the light went.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Began the Worthies and stopped at the laugh
